description: The capabilities TheTrimmer's window needs, and nothing else. The page is web technology rendering text that came from a subtitle file or a file name, so the correct assumption is that anything it can do, something will eventually make it do. It can therefore show a file picker and reveal a file this application just wrote — and it cannot read, write, list, launch or execute anything. Every operation that touches a file, a process or the project store goes through a typed Rust command, so the webview never holds a capability it could be tricked into using.
